sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United will host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach are 1st with 22 points from 10 games, unbeaten in their last five matches (four wins and a draw), and face an Alsager Town side struggling in 19th place with just 4 points and five losses in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points, on a mixed run of D-W-W-L-W-D) visit Dawley Town in a mid-table battle. AFC Bridgnorth, 3rd with 19 points despite a recent loss, host Eccleshall in a clash between two strong sides—though Eccleshall have lost their last outing. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th, 19 points, W-W-D-W-L-W form) travel to Wednesfield Community. In-form Bilston Town (5th, 17 points on W-W-D-W-D-W) face Foley Meir at home. Barnton host Shawbury United in a lower-mid-table fixture between sides on contrasting form (Barnton's W-L-W-D-W-D versus Shawbury's alarming L-L-L-L-L-W streak). Market Drayton Town (12th, mixed recent form) visit high-scoring New Mills (14 points, L-L-D-L-W-D). Cheadle Heath Nomads (7 points, D-D-L-L-L-W) travel to Telford Town (6 points, struggling L-L-L-L-D-D). Crewe host Allscott Heath in a relegation-zone encounter. Brereton Social (11th, 11 points on W-L-D-L-L-D) entertain Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points, winless in 7 games).
